photo.source: the campaign's own self-published portrait from its own site — paigefornh.com, read 2026-08-24 — labelled campaign-provided, remove-on-request
photo.judgment: READ AS AN IMAGE 2026-08-24, tile 2 of 6 on her contact sheet: a clean solo studio portrait on a plain black ground, arms folded, facing camera. She is the unambiguous sole subject and there is no wordmark, banner or third party in frame. The filename paige-arm-cross.png is the publisher saying whose face it is. WHAT WAS REFUSED, all 5: the og:image is a stylised silhouette graphic with no person in it; two are stock landscapes (one is literally named unsplash-image); one is a photograph of merchandise carrying a campaign wordmark; and one is a solo shot in which she wears a shirt printed with a political slogan, refused because a slogan across the subject is the same class as the overlay refused for Menard. PENDING Sean under RULING 55.

hunt.note: Door-3 walk of the site found at Tier A the same day. 6 images staged, 6 read as images on one contact sheet before any verdict.
